description: Remove one file from the site's editable source tree. The served files do not change until build_and_deploy runs.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

path.description: Path inside the source tree to delete, e.g. 'src/old.css'.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: delete_source_file

existed.description: True if the file was present and removed; false if it didn't exist (no-op).

title: Delete a file from the source tree
